clue.text: Sportsman's ring found beside gate

indicators.note: beside says one piece sits next to the other, here gate first and ring after

parts.note: a wicket is a small gate, often set in a larger one
a keeper is a ring worn to hold another ring in place

explanation.surface: A sporting figure's ring turns up lying next to a gate.
explanation.walkthrough: A WICKETKEEPER is the cricket fielder who stands behind the stumps; a keeper ring guards a wedding ring.
explanation.definitionFit: The fielder behind the stumps in cricket is a player, so a kind of sportsman.

clue.text: Reel — catch the source of bagpiper's air?

parts.note: to reel in a line is to wind it
to bag game is to catch it

explanation.surface: A dance tune is linked to where a piper gets the breath to play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reel' suggests the Scottish dance alongside the bagpipes, but it is the verb, as with a fishing reel.
explanation.definitionFit: The inflated leather bag of a set of pipes holds the air the player blows, while the word also means a long-winded talker.

clue.text: French novelist allowed inside shelter

indicators.note: inside says the allowed word goes within the shelter word

parts.note: a cote is a shelter for birds or animals, as in dovecote
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: A writer from France is permitted into a refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: Colette was the pen name of the French author of Gigi and the Claudine books.

clue.text: Applauding former partner practising campanology

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
campanology is bell-ringing, so practising it is tolling bells

explanation.surface: An ex claps while ringing church bells.
explanation.definitionFit: Applauding someone is praising them highly, which is what lauding them to the skies means.

clue.text: Parrot circling soldiers in the old country

indicators.note: circling says the parrot goes round the soldiers

parts.note: the kea is a New Zealand parrot
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A parrot flies round troops stationed abroad in a former homeland.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is fair as the single Asian kingdom that has since been split into North and South.
explanation.definitionFit: The East Asian peninsula state was one nation before its division in 1945, so it is an old country.

clue.text: Half of them depart, accepting court ban

indicators.note: accepting says the half word plus depart take the court word inside
half of says only one half of the word them is used, here its latter pair

parts.note: to go is to depart
the bar is a court or the legal profession pleading there

explanation.surface: Half of a group leaves, putting up with a court's prohibition.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal prohibition on trade with a country is a formal ban.

clue.text: Find fee is adjusted for a well respected Arab

indicators.note: is adjusted says the letters of find and fee are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone discovers a fee being changed for a respected Arab gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: Effendi is a Turkish and Middle Eastern title of respect for a man of standing.

clue.text: Retract article written in college on oriental weapons

indicators.note: written in says the article goes inside the college name

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school, Eton College
a is the indefinite article
E for east, oriental meaning eastern
swords are weapons

explanation.surface: A college writes a piece about eastern weaponry, then takes it back.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit you were wrong and take back what you said is an idiom for withdrawing a statement.

clue.text: Woman at university hired out small band

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name
to let a property is to hire it out

explanation.surface: A woman at university rented out a room.
explanation.definitionFit: An annulet is a little ring, a narrow fillet in architecture or a ring in heraldry.

clue.text: Snubs concerning the old East Kent Regiment

parts.note: re means concerning, about
the Buffs was the nickname of the old East Kent Regiment of the British Army

explanation.surface: A note about the history of a Kent regiment that was cold-shouldered.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebuffs are blunt rejections, the same as snubs.

clue.text: Tool used by impostor to secure shelf

indicators.note: to secure says the impostor word holds the shelf word inside

parts.note: a shammer is one who shams, an impostor
a ledge is a shelf

explanation.surface: A fraudster uses a tool to fix a shelf in place.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy long-handled hammer for breaking stone is a tool.

clue.text: Eye it with a new driver going round town

parts.note: orb is a poetic word for the eye
L is the learner plate shown by a new driver in Britain

explanation.surface: Someone eyes a new motorist circling the town.
explanation.walkthrough: An ORBITAL road in Britain is a ring road circling a town, such as the M25 round London.
explanation.definitionFit: A road that encircles a city is called an orbital, as it loops round the centre.

clue.text: Managed to get into new gear and adapt

indicators.note: get into says the managed word goes inside the rearranged gear
new says the letters of gear are made over into a fresh order

parts.note: ran means managed, as in ran a business

explanation.surface: Someone managed to change into fresh kit and adjust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Managed' looks like the definition, but it is RAN; the anagram 'new' gives ARGE, which 'get into' opens up for the inserted word.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrange music is to adapt it for different instruments.

clue.text: Fine performance on course worth ten dollars once

definitions.meaning: on a golf course, a hole played two under par is a fine score
the old US gold coin worth ten dollars bore this bird's name

explanation.surface: A good round of golf is linked to an old American coin.
explanation.definitionFit: The golf score two under par and the historical ten-dollar gold coin share the bird's name.

clue.text: My claim to be testing and making better

parts.note: my claim to be something is a statement starting I am, shortened to I'm
proving means testing, as in a proving ground

explanation.surface: Someone claims to be trying things out and getting better.
explanation.definitionFit: Improving something is enhancing it, raising its quality.

clue.text: Customer stops near new layout

indicators.note: a new layout says the letters of stops and near are set out afresh

explanation.surface: A shopper halts close to a redesigned shop floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Customer' looks as if it will give PATRON alone, but the whole answer comes from the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A patroness is a female patron, someone who regularly shops at a business.

clue.text: Late working time for small man on board

parts.note: wee is Scottish for small
a knight is a chessman, a man on the chessboard

explanation.surface: A short chess piece works late into the evening.
explanation.definitionFit: An evening during the Monday-to-Friday working week is a late part of a working day.

clue.text: Sort of sea bird in the Orient

indicators.note: sort of says the letters of sea are sorted into another order

parts.note: a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A kind of sea bird is found out in the Far East.
explanation.definitionFit: Something from the Orient is from the East, so an adjective of eastern origin.

clue.text: African territory's main assembly overcoming endless prejudice

indicators.note: overcoming in a down clue puts the first piece on top of the second
assembly says the letters of main are put together in a new order
endless says the final letter of the prejudice word is removed

parts.note: bias is prejudice

explanation.surface: A region of Africa has its chief parliament defeating relentless bigotry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly' rearranges MAIN as NAMI, and 'endless' cuts BIAS to BIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Namibia is a country in south-west Africa, long a territory administered by South Africa.

clue.text: Old PM in Japan or Thailand

indicators.note: in says the answer lies inside the run of words Japan or Thailand

explanation.surface: A former prime minister is found in one Asian nation or another.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord North was the British Prime Minister during the American War of Independence.

clue.text: Eminent baron, say, keeping army

indicators.note: keeping says the baron word holds the army inside

parts.note: a baron is an example of a noble
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: A distinguished baron maintains his own troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Eminent people are distinguished or remarkable, worthy of note.

clue.text: Defence for man briefly supporting racket

indicators.note: supporting in a down clue puts the man below, holding up the racket

parts.note: a ramp is slang for a swindle or racket
Art is a short form of the man's name Arthur

explanation.surface: Protection for a fellow who backs a racket.
explanation.definitionFit: A rampart is a defensive wall or bank round a fort, so a defence.

clue.text: Began again, producing problem in plant

indicators.note: in says the problem goes inside the plant

parts.note: a reed is a waterside plant
a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: Work restarted, bringing trouble at a factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' suggests a factory, but it is the botanical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: To resume is to start again after a break.

clue.text: Note seized by father — an object of fear

indicators.note: seized by says the note is held within the father word

parts.note: dad is father
re is the second note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A father grabs a musical note, something to be afraid of.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread is great fear, and by extension the thing feared.

clue.text: Best opening for traders in drug many injected

indicators.note: injected says the many letter is put into the drug as well
in says the trader letter goes inside the drug

parts.note: opium is a narcotic drug

indicators.note: opening for says only the first letter of traders is used

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, hence many

explanation.surface: The best chance for dealers is in a drug many have injected.
explanation.walkthrough: Two separate insertions: 'in' places the trader letter after the second letter of the drug, and 'injected' puts the Roman thousand two places later.
explanation.definitionFit: The optimum is the most favourable condition, the best possible.

clue.text: Apparent location of bishop possessing great skill

parts.note: a see is a bishop's diocese or seat
able means skilful, capable

explanation.surface: A bishop's seat is visibly held by someone very talented.
explanation.definitionFit: Something apparent can be seen, being visible.

clue.text: Welcome British in eastern club

indicators.note: in says the British piece goes inside the eastern club

parts.note: a mace is a spiked club

explanation.surface: Britons are warmly received at a club in the east.
explanation.definitionFit: To embrace an idea or person is to welcome them gladly.

clue.text: Glowing example of Peruvian attack

parts.note: an Incan is one of the Inca people of ancient Peru
a descent is a sudden attack, as in a descent on the coast

explanation.surface: A heated instance of a Peruvian offensive.
explanation.definitionFit: Incandescent means glowing white-hot, giving out light from heat.
